scope: Round 15. 'Beat it! Look' restyle: the site keeps its name Beat'em (user, 2026-11-19); only the look changes, from the current dark navy style to the 'Beat it! Look' visual system (LOT-POP-Brand-Guidelines.md) following the 5 mockup screens in 'Pop Art Auction UI.html' (Homepage, Lot page, Chat widget, Footer, Mobile quick bid). This is a UI round: it restyles and rearranges pages that already exist and shows only data the API already has. Every business rule and API from rounds 1-14 (archived in progress-feature-list/) stays: bids checked against available credit and the increment ladder, realtime SSE, idle logout, roles/permissions, staff chat handoff, RAG chat. All 75 existing Playwright specs must keep passing (selectors/text updated only where the rebrand changes visible copy, never to weaken a check). One feature per function, like round 8 (ui-<page>.<n>), here pop-<area>.<n>.

readings_to_confirm: Brand name (decided by the user 2026-11-19): the site stays 'Beat'em'. The guideline's look (colours, type, halftone, outlines, sound words) is applied, but the name 'LOT POP!', its tagline 'Auctions with a bang.' and the lotpop-mark files are NOT used. The wordmark is live text "Beat'em" in Bangers styled like the guideline's wordmark (ink + pow-red accent on the last word part); the existing fe/public/logo.svg stays as the mark and favicon, recoloured to the brand palette. The guideline's components/bundle.js (window.LotPop) is not in the repo, so the components are rebuilt as small React components in fe/src/components/ui.

Light theme only: the brand page ground is paper #FFF8E7; the current dark tokens are replaced, not kept as a dark mode. Staff/admin charts keep their own series colours, re-checked for contrast on paper.

Mockup items with no data or API today are left out of this round, not faked: watchlist ('My watchlist', 'Save the ones you love'), auto-bid / max bid, newsletter signup (footer band), seller stats ('Verified seller', 'N lots sold'), condition grade / inspected by, specs (maker, model, serial, size, estimate), shipping & pickup details, buyer's premium %, 'Ships from', footer pages that do not exist (Careers, Press, Blog, Seller handbook...). Placeholders like [SELLER NAME] in the mockup map to real fields where one exists (seller username, goods.condition, category, start price, start/end time) and are hidden otherwise. Each left-out item is listed under 'deferred'.

Lot page tabs: Description (auction/goods description), Condition (goods.condition text, plus 'Ask the auction desk in the chat' link), Seller (username + 'See more lots from this seller' -> existing search filtered by seller if supported, else hidden). 'Shipping & pickup' tab is deferred (no data).

Lot cards: the guideline says the whole card is one link with no nested buttons, but round 8 (ui-1a.3) put quick bid / Custom bid buttons on cards. Reading: the card's art + text block is the link; the quick-bid row sits below it inside the same outlined frame as a sibling, not inside the link. Existing ui-1a.3 behaviour and its spec stay.

Quick bid amounts: lot page keeps QUICK_STEPS [1, 2, 5] x increment (matches the mockup). The mobile band's chips use the same quickAmounts from bidMath.ts instead of the mockup's fixed +25/+50/+100, so the increment ladder still rules.

Sound words follow the bank only: POW! after a successful bid, BAM! on a won lot (My biddings / win toast), KAPOW! after registering, ZAP! on live/new, GONE! on sold/ended. Never on errors, outbids, credit/payments, password or legal copy. Outbid copy: 'You've been outbid - jump back in?'.

Chat widget suggestion chips: the mockup's 'How does auto-bid work?' and 'Shipping costs?' ask about things the site does not have; chips become 'How do I bid?', 'How does credit work?', 'Condition report'. Bot/staff modes, offline state and handoff from rounds 13-14 stay.

Header nav 'Live now' / 'Ending soon' / 'Categories' link to the existing browse page with the matching sort/filter (ui-1a.2); 'Sell with us' goes to the existing create-auction / My goods flow for signed-in customers and to Sign in for guests. Role-based nav for staff/admin stays.
Countdown uses the server end time already sent by the API; the 5-minute and 1-minute marks are announced once each through an aria-live=polite region, the timer itself is aria-live=off.

acceptance: <= 640px: band position sticky/fixed bottom, zap-yellow, 4px ink top rule; does not cover the footer's last link (page gets bottom padding).
Chips = quickAmounts (increment ladder); selected chip sets 'You'll bid $X'; button 'Bid $X!' uses the same bid call and checks as BidPanel (no second code path).
Clock reuses Countdown helpers; ended lot hides the band.
Touch targets >= 44px; POW! burst on success; errors plain.
